Use style.pointerEvents' (originates from batch-buy.web.tsx line 92 and batch-buy.tsx line 82).

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated `pointerEvents` prop instead of `style.pointerEvents`. Console warning fires on every mount of Multiple Buy screen. Reference: /app/frontend/app/batch-buy.tsx:82 and /app/frontend/app/batch-buy.web.tsx:92 — move `pointerEvents: 'none'` from the JSX prop into the style object.

action_items: Minor: In /app/frontend/app/batch-buy.tsx:82 and /app/frontend/app/batch-buy.web.tsx:92, change `<View style={styles.overlay} pointerEvents="none">` (currently passed as prop inside array-style) to put pointerEvents in the style: `<View style={[styles.overlay, { pointerEvents: 'none' }]}/>` is exactly the deprecated form React Native flags — set `pointerEvents: 'none'` on `styles.overlay` itself via StyleSheet.create OR use `style={{...styles.overlay, pointerEvents:'none'}}`. Not functionally breaking, but the deprecation will hard-fail in a future RN release.

OPTIONAL: /app/frontend/app/buying-trip.tsx still exists on disk though it is no longer linked from Home. Consider deleting the file (or leaving it as dead code is acceptable since routing no longer references it).

Both native and web batch screens call the SAME /api/buy endpoint with `override:true` — matches backend curl verification (3 buys => stock_count=3).

batch-buy.web.tsx uses `unstable_createElement('video', …)` (react-native-web) which is the standard workaround to embed a native <video> tag in RN Web — proper for ZXing integration.
batch-buy.tsx line 82 & batch-buy.web.tsx line 92 use deprecated `pointerEvents: 'none'` inside the style array — React Native warns. See action_items.
